concerns.text: FR-006 requires the system to 'flag the result as Low Power - Interpret with Caution' and proceed to generate the story, but Task T005b mandates raising a `LowPowerError` and halting pipeline execution immediately. This creates a missing task for the 'propagation' of the low-power flag to the final story (Edge Cases) without stopping the pipeline.

FR-003 requires a specific JSON array output with static thresholds (p < 0.05, |r| > 0.15). Task T021a instructs a 'sweep' of thresholds and generation of a range of results, which does not match the single deterministic artifact required by FR-003. No task exists to implement the specific FR-003 output format (static thresholds).

US-2 and Edge Cases require generating SQL/Python queries to test counterfactuals with retry logic. Task T024 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and lacks the explicit implementation of the retry logic and query generation required to satisfy the 'Independent Test' for US-2.

FR-003 and SC-002 require a specific JSON output including `stability_score` and `validity_status`. Task T021b is marked incomplete and depends on T023c (also incomplete) to define the schema. There is no completed task ensuring the final FR-003 artifact includes these specific fields.

The spec's Edge Cases require reporting 'Low Power' flags in the final story. Task T005d (incomplete) is the only task addressing this propagation, but it is not linked to the final synthesis logic in US-3 (T028a/T029), leaving the requirement for 'flagging' in the final output unimplemented.

SC-004 requires measuring 'Verification Traceability' as the percentage of claims with valid, executable citations. Task T035 defines the regex and logic but is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). No completed task exists to execute this metric calculation and write the result to `output/traceability_metrics.json`.

SC-001 requires calculating the arithmetic mean of expert scores. Task T034 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and relies on T032b/c (also incomplete) for the expert scores. No completed task exists to aggregate these metrics and write to `output/metrics_report.json`.

SC-001 requires a Kappa check protocol (≥ 0.6) with a 4th expert fallback. Task T032b is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and depends on T032a/d (incomplete). The logic for triggering the 4th expert and halting on failure is not implemented.
SC-001 requires calculating the arithmetic mean of valid expert scores. Task T032c is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and depends on T032b. No completed task exists to perform this calculation.
